Hero.subtitle: Drive the car of your dreams.

advancedTech.title: Advanced technology
advancedTech.description: Simucube force feedback wheels, high-end pedals and ultra-immersive screens. The ultimate in professional simulation.

drivingCourses.title: Driving courses
drivingCourses.description: For beginners and experienced drivers alike. Learn and refine your skills on track in a realistic virtual environment.

uniqueVenue.title: A unique venue
uniqueVenue.description: Much more than a simulator centre. Relax in our friendly lounge and never miss a live sporting event.

Simulateurs.title: Our

tripleScreen.title: Triple Screen Cockpit
tripleScreen.description: Total immersion with our setups featuring three curved screens, Simucube Direct Drive wheel and hydraulic pedals.
tripleScreen.alt: Triple screen simulator cockpit with Simucube wheel

pedalPro.title: Pro Pedals
pedalPro.description: Progressive braking and ultra-realistic feel thanks to our professional pedals with load cell technology.

racingChassis.title: Racing Chassis
racingChassis.description: Rigid aluminium chassis that faithfully reproduce the driving position of a real racing car.

directDrive.title: Direct Drive Wheel
directDrive.description: Simucube force feedback wheels to feel every kerb, every understeer with surgical precision.

AboutPage.metaDescription: Discover the story of The Sim Power, founded by Stephane Lewahert. Passion, excellence and innovation at the service of sim racing.
AboutPage.heroDescription: The story, vision and team behind The Sim Power
AboutPage.teamDescription: Racing enthusiasts at the service of your experience

member1.name: Stephane Lewahert
member1.description: Passionate about motorsport, Stephane founded The Sim Power to make high-end simulation accessible to all. His vision: combining cutting-edge technology with conviviality.

member2.name: Nathan Lewahert
member2.description: An experienced driver, he guides our visitors in their progress and introduces them to the subtleties of circuit driving.

member3.name: Coming soon
member3.description: Guarantor of the quality of our equipment, he ensures the proper functioning of our simulators and the integration of the latest technologies.

member4.name: Coming soon
member4.description: Organisation specialist, he designs tailor-made events: team buildings, birthdays, competitions and themed evenings.

passion.title: Passion
passion.description: Sim racing is much more than a hobby. It is a passion we share with each of our visitors.

excellence.title: Excellence
excellence.description: From equipment to customer service, we strive for excellence at every stage of the experience.

innovation.title: Innovation
innovation.description: We constantly invest in the latest technologies to offer unparalleled immersion.

conviviality.title: Conviviality
conviviality.description: Our centres are meeting places where everyone feels at home.

milestone1.title: Birth of the project
milestone1.description: Stephane Lewahert imagines a unique place where automotive passion and cutting-edge technology meet.

milestone3.title: Expansion to Mons
milestone3.description: Building on success, a second centre opens in Mons with a bar area and family-friendly atmosphere.

milestone4.title: Terminal 1
milestone4.description: The third centre, Terminal 1, pushes the experience even further with latest generation simulators.
